subtitle.en_US: Melting the old into the new

text.zh_CN:
中级坩埚和普通坩埚一样，需要装满水，并放在火、岩浆或者灯火之上加热。水沸腾后才会工作，溶解的要素也会像普通坩埚那样慢慢蒸发，溢出时会产生咒波。
用法杖右键坩埚可以在分解模式与合成模式之间切换；潜行时用法杖右键会倒空坩埚。
分解模式：丢进去的物品都会被分解为要素。
text.en_US:
Like the common crucible, the intermediate crucible must be filled with water and heated by fire, lava or a nitor below it. It works only once the water boils; dissolved essentia slowly boils off as in the common crucible, and overflowing essentia becomes flux.
Right-click the crucible with a wand to switch between decomposition and synthesis mode; sneak while doing so to empty it.
Decomposition mode: every item thrown in dissolves into its aspects.

text.zh_CN:
合成模式：坩埚最多容纳两种材料。最后一种材料放入一分钟后，或者空手右键坩埚时，材料会与溶解的要素发生反应。
如果材料和要素符合一个你已掌握的配方，就会得到产物；否则材料会被毁掉，坩埚上方会冒出咒波粘浆或咒波瓦斯。
例如：神秘锭与下界合金锭，加上 2 份古代与 4 份魔力，可以炼成远古神秘锭。
text.en_US:
Synthesis mode: the crucible holds up to two materials. A minute after the last one went in, or when you right-click the crucible with an empty hand, they react with the dissolved essentia.
If the materials and essentia match a recipe you know, the result rises out of the crucible; otherwise the materials are ruined and flux goo or flux gas spills out.
For example, a thaumium ingot and a netherite ingot with 2 Antiquitas and 4 Praecantatio make an ancient thaumium ingot.
